title: Rosacea treatment
what: Rosacea is long-lasting redness of the face, sometimes with pimples and tiny visible veins. It cannot be cured once and for all, but it can be kept well under control.
why: When your face often flushes and burns, and pimples appear on the cheeks and nose.
duration: the visit usually takes 20 to 30 minutes; treatment lasts weeks and months
tell_doctor: What makes the redness worse: sun, heat, spicy food, alcohol, stress
Which creams and medicines you have already used
Whether you have dryness, burning or red eyes

prepare.title: Skin
prepare.text: Come to the visit without makeup.

prepare.title: Products
prepare.text: Bring the creams and cosmetics you use.

prepare.title: Photos
prepare.text: Take a photo of your face during a flare-up.

bring: A photo of your face during a flare-up
The creams and cosmetics you use
steps: The doctor asks questions and examines your facial skin
Sometimes looks at the skin under magnification
Prescribes a cream, gel or tablets
For visible veins may suggest laser or light treatment
Chooses gentle care and sun protection
feel: Treatment works gradually, usually over several weeks
after: Wash with a gentle cleanser, no scrubs
Write down what triggers redness and avoid it
Do not stop treatment if you do not see the effect right away
red_flags: Severe eye pain, sensitivity to light or worse vision: see a doctor urgently

faq.q: Is rosacea caused by poor skin care?
faq.a: No. It is a trait of the skin. Care helps, but it is not the cause.
Yes, gentle makeup without irritating ingredients. The doctor can advise what to look for.
